producerEvidence.aggregation: Mean of _prob for rows whose nearest facility type matches the facility record type and whose in_buffer_strict flag equals 1.
producerEvidence.fallback: When that mean is NaN, the exporter writes numeric probability 0.5.
producerEvidence.ambiguity: The wire artifact cannot distinguish a genuine rounded model mean of 0.5 from that fallback. A NaN mean can arise from no eligible rows or from eligible rows with no finite probability; legacy-v0 has no counts to distinguish them.
producerEvidence.receiptBoundary: The inventory records byte identity and donor revision for the exporter, model artifacts, probability maps, and legacy JSON. It does not provide record-level missingness semantics or a fit-time preprocessing lineage receipt.

limitation.consumerRule: Do not classify legacy numeric 0.5 as available, unavailable, modeled, fallback, failure, or not assessed. Preserve the numeric value and display or retain the limitation until a conforming v1 artifact is regenerated.
limitation.recoverability: Record-level status and reason cannot be recovered from legacy-v0 bytes alone.

implementationEvidence.use: fillna(0) for both training and held-out feature matrices
fillna(0) for full-panel training and per-event inference

trackedPanelAudit.interpretation: At this reviewed matrix boundary, fillna(0) is a no-op for the tracked panel. This does not prove that upstream missing observations were absent, retained, or handled correctly before panel construction.

blockedBecause: No versioned preprocessing contract defines which source-level missing states may be zero-imputed.
No missing indicators distinguish an imputed zero from an observed numeric zero on future or alternate panels.
The fitted model artifacts and generated probability maps lack a fit-time receipt linking their exact training matrix, feature engineering, missingness audit, and preprocessing version.
No LOEO sensitivity compares current zero-fill with declared missing indicators or a fold-fitted imputer.
preprocessingAssessment.currentAction: Preserve existing code and values. Do not call zero-fill scientifically admitted and do not change it from this contract-only lane.
evidenceRequiredToUnblock: Version and receipt the pre-feature and post-feature missingness matrix by event and LOEO fold.
Declare which features have a scientifically meaningful observed zero and which require a missing indicator or a fold-fitted imputer.
Run a bounded LOEO calibration, discrimination, and per-record probability-shift comparison across the declared preprocessing alternatives.
Link the selected preprocessing version, training matrix receipt, fitted model versions, probability-map versions, and facility producer version.

regenerationRequirements: eligible and finite pixel counts per record
explicit status and reason per record

dualReadWindow.starts: when the first conforming v1 artifact is integrated
dualReadWindow.ends: after all 25 event artifacts are regenerated under v1, the Dashboard adapter passes v1 conformance, and one complete release retains explicit legacy-v0 read-only support
dualReadWindow.retirementEarliest: the next major Dashboard release after a manifest proves no production reference to legacy-v0

dashboard: Keep the legacy limitation code unchanged and do not infer the meaning of numeric 0.5.
Add a v1 adapter only after producer artifacts conform; render available numeric 0.5 only when status is available, and render all null statuses from status/reason rather than a numeric sentinel.
Keep legacy-v0 and v1 paths explicit throughout the dual-read window; never auto-wrap a legacy array as v1.
handoffs.public: No direct Public change is required. If Public later consumes producer freshness/error states, reuse the status/reason separation but do not expose facility probabilities, recovery labels, scores, or ranks.
